label: Быть
description: Scaffold verb card for irregular survival grammar. Expand each person into five sentences for the full 30-line deck.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Past tense. 1. 'Был' is the masculine past form. 2. 'Дома' gives a natural location. 3. This is one of the most useful survival patterns.
Strategic focus: Feminine past tense. 1. 'Была' changes with gender. 2. 'Занята' is a concise state adjective. 3. The sentence is practical for everyday conversation.
Strategic focus: Future form. 1. 'Будет' is the irregular future stem. 2. 'Готов' gives a clear state result. 3. This is a core planning sentence.
Strategic focus: Plural past tense. 1. 'Были' is the plural past form. 2. 'Там' is a short and useful location adverb. 3. The sentence is compact and reusable.
Strategic focus: Polite/plural future. 1. 'Будете' is the plural future form. 2. 'Готовы' keeps the outcome clear. 3. This is useful for planning and instruction.
Strategic focus: Third-person plural future. 1. 'Будут' closes the irregular scaffold. 2. 'Здесь' makes the sentence easy to visualize. 3. This is a clean ending point for the card.
